title: Terminal Lobby Usage
description: Feature usage (ADR-0006) and client health (ADR-0008) for the terminal lobby. The health rows are collapsed by default: open one when something felt wrong. Every query strips the journal's log prefix before parsing and addresses the dotted keys with bracket notation — the record's field names contain literal dots, so a dotted path would walk objects that do not exist.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Total usage events in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json user="[\"user.id\"]" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions started
panels.description: session.attached — every session start, including plain ttyd URLs that never touch the lobby.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "session.attached" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "app.loaded" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Errors seen
panels.description: app.error — a toast the user actually saw. The strongest "this needs work" signal here.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "app.error" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "claude.prompt_sent" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Features by use, per user
panels.description: The core question: which parts of the lobby earn their keep, and whether wizard and emo use it differently.

targets.expr: sum by (name, user) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Which tool sessions run
panels.description: session.attached by command key — claude / codex / shell / none (tmux default-command).

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", kind="attrs[\"tl.kind\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "session.attached" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))
sum by (user) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json user="[\"user.id\"]" | user =~ "$user" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Keyboard vs pointer (command dispatch)
panels.description: palette.action counts every command dispatch — palette pick, chord, or forwarded shortcut.

targets.expr: sum by (key) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", key="attrs[\"tl.key\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "palette.action" | user =~ "$user" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Prefs and themes people change
panels.description: Which knobs actually get turned — a default worth revisiting is one that keeps getting changed.

targets.expr: sum by (key, to) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", key="attrs[\"tl.key\"]", to="attrs[\"tl.to\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name =~ "prefs.changed|theme.changed" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))
{job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLEVENT" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLEVENT " __line__ "" }}` | json user="[\"user.id\"]" | user =~ "$user"

panels.title: Latency — how it felt
panels.description: Client-measured timings. Absent series mean nobody was typing, not that latency was zero.

panels.title: Echo round-trip, p95 by device
panels.description: Keystroke to the first byte back, sampled only when the terminal was output-idle beforehand. Read it next to 'usable echo samples' below: a p95 drawn from a handful of samples is a different claim from one drawn from hundreds.

targets.expr: max by (device) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", device="attrs[\"tl.device\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.echo.p95\"]" | name = "perf.rollup" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Client-side cost: input path and render
panels.description: Neither leg leaves the device, so these are unconfounded by the network: keydown to ws.send, and xterm write to its render callback.

targets.expr: max by (device) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", device="attrs[\"tl.device\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.input.p95\"]" | name = "perf.rollup" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

max by (device) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", device="attrs[\"tl.device\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.render.p95\"]" | name = "perf.rollup" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Usable echo samples
panels.description: How many echo measurements passed the quiet gate.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.echo.n\"]" | name = "perf.rollup" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Discarded as unpairable
panels.description: Keystrokes whose echo never arrived within the deadline, or that could not be paired unambiguously. A high share next to a low usable count means the gate is too strict for how this terminal is actually used.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.echo.unmatched\"]" | name = "perf.rollup" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Stalls
panels.description: Input went out and nothing came back for longer than the threshold.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "term.stall" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Frames dropped
panels.description: Animation frames that arrived more than 100 ms after the previous one, while the tab was visible.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.jank.n\"]" | name = "perf.rollup" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__range]))

panels.title: WebSocket drops
panels.description: Every deploy restarts ttyd and drops every open socket, which is why a drop carries a reason — deploy churn is separable from real instability.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", reason="attrs[\"tl.reason\"]" | name = "conn.dropped" | user =~ "$user" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Close codes
panels.description: 1006 is an abnormal closure with no close frame — the shape a network drop takes, as opposed to a clean server-side close.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", code="attrs[\"tl.code\"]" | name = "conn.dropped" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Tabs that died without closing
panels.description: A page life that ended with no pagehide: killed by the OS, a browser crash, or a device that never woke up. Counted at the NEXT boot.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name = "app.died" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

max by (device) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", device="attrs[\"tl.device\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.handshake_ms\"]" | name = "conn.opened" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

max by (device) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", device="attrs[\"tl.device\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.token_ms\"]" | name = "conn.opened" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Exceptions, most frequent first
panels.description: Deduped in the browser by message and top frame, so a looping error is one record carrying its own count rather than hundreds of lines.

targets.expr: sum by (msg, src) (count_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", msg="attrs[\"tl.msg\"]", src="attrs[\"tl.src\"]" | name = "app.exception" | user =~ "$user" [$__range]))

panels.title: Slow calls: what the client saw vs what the server took
panels.description: The gap between the two lines is network and device time. Join an individual pair on tl.req to attribute one specific slow call.

targets.expr: max by (ep) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", ep="attrs[\"tl.ep\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.ms\"]" | name = "api.slow" | user =~ "$user" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

max by (ep) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", ep="attrs[\"tl.ep\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.ms\"]" | name = "api.served" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Incidents, with the events that led to them
panels.description: tl.trace on each of these is the flight recorder: the raw input events immediately before the failure.

targets.expr: {job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]" | name =~ "diag.incident|term.stall|conn.dropped|app.exception" | user =~ "$user"

panels.title: Server-side endpoint latency
panels.description: What the handlers themselves cost, per service and endpoint group. This is the baseline the client-side numbers are read against: a client p95 far above the matching line here is network or device time, not the devvm. Carries no user — it is a per-service distribution rather than one person's activity.

targets.expr: max by (svc, ep) (max_over_time({job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", svc="[\"service.name\"]", ep="attrs[\"tl.ep\"]", v="attrs[\"tl.p95\"]" | name = "api.rollup" | unwrap v | __error__ = "" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Boot timing and device context
panels.description: One row per tab boot: how long the page took to load and what it was loaded on. This is where 'it is slow on my phone' becomes a number.

targets.expr: {job="devvm-journal"} |= "TLDIAG" | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?TLDIAG " __line__ "" }}` | json name="[\"event.name\"]", user="[\"user.id\"]", ttfb="attrs[\"tl.nav.ttfb\"]", load="attrs[\"tl.nav.load\"]", bytes="attrs[\"tl.nav.bytes\"]", net="attrs[\"tl.net.type\"]", rtt="attrs[\"tl.net.rtt\"]", cpu="attrs[\"tl.dev.cpu\"]", mem="attrs[\"tl.dev.mem\"]", plat="attrs[\"tl.dev.plat\"]" | name = "app.context" | user =~ "$user"
